# FlipConcept first read notes

PDF: arXiv 2502.15203v2, 7 pages. Page numbers are PDF pages.

## Numbers that could not be read

None.

## Curves that are plot-only

None. Figures 1 to 4 show images and a pipeline diagram, and print no result value.

## Protocol facts a comparison depends on

**Model and resolution.** All experiments use the Stable Diffusion v2.1 base model at 512x512 (p4).

**Data.** The evaluation uses Custom Concept 101 plus images generated by Stable Diffusion, in five evaluation sets, with prompts generated by ChatGPT (p4).

**Sample count.** The paper generates 50 images per method (p4). It does not say whether that is per set or in total. Tables II and III do not restate a count.

**Metrics.** T_CLIP is cosine similarity between image and prompt. I_CLIP and I_DINO are cosine similarity on region-specific embeddings (p4).

**Fixed settings.** alpha = 0.15 and beta = 0.8 (p4).

**Background selection.** Backgrounds are generated, kept only when CLIP text-image similarity is above 0.3, and then picked by a user so the target object is clearly visible (p2). This hand selection comes before the scored images.

**Not stated.** Seeds, sampling steps and guidance scale are not stated.

## Hardware and time

Experiments run on two NVIDIA A40 GPUs (p4). Table II (p5) prints additional training, inference and total time in seconds. It does not state how many images or concepts each time covers, or whether background generation and the user's pick are inside FlipConcept's 86 s. FlipConcept has the longest inference time of the four methods (86 s against 7 to 16 s) and the shortest total because its additional training is 0.

## Contradictions inside the paper

**Model used.** p4 says all experiments use Stable Diffusion v2.1 base. p2 says the backgrounds are generated with Stable Diffusion XL.

**Ablation claim against Table III (p6).** The caption says each component contributes meaningfully, and the text says each component substantially enhances performance. In the table, adding guided appearance attention lowers T_CLIP from 0.3737 to 0.3733. Adding background dilution lowers I_CLIP from 0.8711 to 0.8655 and I_DINO from 0.6232 to 0.6130.

The arithmetic in Table II holds on all four rows, and row (d) of Table I equals row (d) of Table III.
